text:
```yaml
name: Claude Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/

      - name: Check for CLA signature
        uses: cla-checker/clabot-action@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr_number: ${{ github.event.number }}
          org_name: NVIDIA-NeMo
          repo_name: Evaluator
          clabot_config_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/CLA/master/clabot-config.json
```
